Name: Adarin's Girl Mod - Content Patcher
Author: ZidanReign
Description:
[size=4]I decided to make a Content Patcher Version for[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/474?tab=description][u] [b]Adarin's Genderbends Mod[/b][/u][/url] since it makes for a less painful installation.  [/size]

[size=5][b][u][size=4]For dialogue replacement, I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Updated Adarin Girl Dialogue Mod[/url].[/size][/u]

[u]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/u]
[u]
THIS IS ONLY COMPATIBLE WITH STARDEW VALLEY'S LATEST VERSION.  DO NOT ATTEMPT TO USE THIS UNLESS YOU ARE ON THE LATEST VERSION, NOT PRE 1.3.[/u]

[/b][/size][b][size=6]Credits[/size]
[/b][size=4]Thank [b]Adarin[/b] for his genderswap mod.  Since he is MIA, I have done this content patcher port unofficially.  If he ever wishes to have me take this mod down, I will. 

Thanks to the various people that mentioned problems with sprites so that I would take the time to correct them.  Thanks specifically to [b]t4k0y4k1[/b] for his fix for Harvey and [b]Invartozen[/b] for his fixing of Sebastian's Portraits for white spots that I didn't know existed.  Thanks to commenter [b]sapp[/b] for providing a cleaner method of editing Cursors.xnb for the mod for fewer incompatibilities with other mods.[/size]

Downloads.Description:
Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. Please use the latest Stardew Valley Version.
Replaces Cursors Mod with cleaner code and a single image provided by commenter sapp.
